matching_policy: Exact normalized product name AND brand only; ambiguous or partial matches are rejected.
update_schedule: 03:00 UTC daily (05:00 Africa/Cairo during Egypt winter time); also runs on relevant pushes and manual dispatch.

sources.name: PriceLens Egypt multi-store offers API
sources.refresh_policy: API values refreshed hourly; updater requests offers no older than 24 hours; cache not more than 24 hours.
sources.attribution: Display Prices by PriceLens with a link to https://pricelens.store; preserve returned affiliate link exactly.
sources.activation_note: API key and provider plan required. Documentation advertises a 7-day trial and monthly plans. Adapter reads up to 10 pages (1,000 recent deals) per daily run, exact-matches product name and brand, and rejects out-of-stock offers. Keep inactive until an adult account owner obtains the key and confirms the plan.

sources.name: Sama Link Store official partner integration API
sources.activation_note: Sama Link issues the integration key after contact; API is server-to-server. Use only products that match an existing catalog entry by exact normalized name and brand.

sources.name: EGID official EGX market data API
sources.refresh_policy: Automatic browser refresh every 30 seconds in licensed live mode or every 60 seconds in delayed mode, only while the stock section is visible; Cloudflare edge cache is 5 seconds.
sources.attribution: Display EGID as source; preserve the market-data timestamp and the granted delay designation.
sources.activation_note: Obtain API access credentials and written permission for public/commercial display from EGID. Store the issued bearer token as the Cloudflare Worker secret EGID_API_TOKEN. Keep delayed mode until EGID explicitly authorizes live redistribution; set EGID_FEED_MODE=live only after that approval.

reference_sources.name: Central Bank of Egypt
reference_sources.reason: Official published exchange rates; no verified public JSON feed or redistribution license was established in this review.

reference_sources.name: EGID (EGX Information Dissemination)
reference_sources.reason: Official Swagger documents live Feed and DelayedFeed endpoints. Public display requires EGID-issued API credentials and confirmation of redistribution rights.

reference_sources.name: Egyptian Drug Authority
reference_sources.reason: Official registration and product information database; not a verified public price feed.

reference_sources.name: CAPMAS
reference_sources.reason: Published statistical indices are not live individual retail product prices.

reference_sources.name: Obour Market
reference_sources.reason: Wholesale market bulletins are not a general licensed retail JSON feed.

reference_sources.name: Daleelak Egypt market rates API
reference_sources.reason: Provider states the free feed is for information only and its commercial license is not yet available.

reference_sources.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation — daily crop prices
reference_sources.reason: The official page presents wholesale Obour Market and representative retail prices for vegetables, fruit and fish. Automated query responses did not expose a verified machine-readable price table, and commercial reuse terms were not confirmed. Do not ingest until the Ministry confirms an approved export/API and reuse permission.

reference_sources.name: Open Prices community observations
reference_sources.reason: Community-submitted price observations are under ODbL terms; Egypt-specific EGP coverage was not established. Keep separate from proprietary retail feeds unless database-license compatibility and attribution obligations are reviewed.

reference_sources.name: Information and Decision Support Center — local and global prices
reference_sources.reason: The official IDSC describes daily local prices for 30+ commodities including vegetables, fruit, meat, construction materials and fertilizers, but a public machine-readable API and commercial redistribution terms were not verified. Seek an approved data feed rather than extracting app traffic.

excluded_categories_note: Do not activate sources for medicines or other restricted products through this generic updater. Use official public registration information only; no unverified price claims.

egid_runtime.authentication: Bearer token held only in Cloudflare Worker secret
